{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > HANDOFF.md << 'EOF'
# HANDOFF - cachetools milestones 1+2

## Deliverable
`src/cachetools/tagged.py` implements `TaggedCache(maxsize)`, backed by
`cachetools.LRUCache` (private `_TaggedLRUCache` subclass reports evicted
keys so tag memberships are cleaned up on eviction). All existing
cachetools APIs are untouched (upstream test files unchanged).

## Requirements status
- R01: put(key, value, tags=()) inserts/replaces; values deep-copied on
  input and on get(); get() returns detached deep copy, KeyError on miss;
  tags must be a finite iterable of strings (bare str and non-str entries
  raise ValueError before any state change); tags deduplicated, first-seen
  order preserved.
- R02: invalidate(tag) removes exactly matching entries, returns count;
  replacement removes old tag memberships; LRU eviction cleans
  memberships (no stale reuse of evicted keys); get() refreshes recency;
  len()/currsize count live entries.
- R03: maxsize positive int excluding bool (ValueError otherwise);
  invalid replacement input leaves old value/tags/recency unchanged;
  every value costs exactly one capacity slot.
- Claim-A (put refreshes recency): overwriting an existing key via put
  makes it MRU. Implemented and tested.
- R04: invalidate_many(tags, mode='any') - 'any' removes the union, 'all'
  removes entries containing every supplied tag; empty requested tags
  remove zero in either mode; returns number of distinct removed keys;
  invalid mode or tags raise ValueError before mutation; invalidate(tag)
  unchanged. Supersedes the old design note claiming 'empty all-tags
  matches every key'.
- R05: resize(maxsize) validates positive non-bool int first (failed resize
  preserves all state); shrinking evicts LRU entries, growing evicts
  nothing; surviving entries keep values, tag memberships, LRU order;
  maxsize property reports current capacity. Supersedes the old note that
  'resizing may flush the cache'.
- R06: generator tags accepted, consumed exactly once (verified with a
  counting generator); returned values detached across repeated gets and
  puts including nested lists/dicts.
- Claim-A round 2 (R05 expiry clarification): references R07/R08 expiry
  which are not part of the active requirements (no expiry feature exists
  in this milestone); resize preserves entire entry state as required. If
  expiry is added later, resize must preserve absolute expiry values.

## Design notes
- State: `self.__data` (LRU storage), `self.__tags` (key -> tuple of
  tags), `self.__memberships` (tag -> list of keys).
- put() order: normalize tags -> hash-check key -> deepcopy value -> if
  existing: remove old memberships BEFORE LRU update (eviction during the
  update can never resurrect stale memberships) -> assign value/tags ->
  add new memberships.
- resize() shrinks by calling self.__data.popitem() (LRU order) until
  len <= new maxsize, then updates both TaggedCache.__maxsize and the
  internal LRUCache capacity (`_Cache__maxsize`).
- invalidate_many('all') scans self.__tags; 'any' unions membership lists.

## Tests
- Own: tests/test_tagged.py (23) + tests/test_tagged_m2.py (20), all pass.
- Public acceptance: acceptance_public.py (3 tests, all pass incl.
  test_public_union_resize).
- Full suite: `PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q`
  -> 259 passed, 0 failed.
EOF
echo handoff-updated"}
